deny.english-code: code must be in English only: identifiers, comments, and logs. Test files are excluded: test names and test data can use the language of the project. Put user-facing text in the translation file (lang/, locales/, i18n/) and use the key through the i18n of the stack. See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/english-code.md. For user-facing text, load ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/i18n.md for the pattern of each stack.
deny.test-id: every interactive element of a component needs data-testid: button, a, input, select, textarea, form, and every element with a click, submit, change, or input handler. Use a business name in kebab-case (profile-save-button). In a repeated item, use the business id (item-card-${item.sku}), never the position. A wrapper that forwards the attributes of the parent (v-bind="$attrs" in Vue, {...rest} in React) passes. See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/test-ids.md.
deny.test-skip: do not skip, focus, or disable a test (.skip, .only, .todo, xit, fit, markTestSkipped, t.Skip, #[ignore], @Disabled). A red test shows what the code lacks: fix the code. If the specification changed, change the test together with it. See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/atdd.md.
deny.e2e-container: an E2E test runs only in a container, never on the host. Run it with the e2e service of the compose file: docker compose run --rm e2e <command>. If the project has no e2e service yet, create it with the official image of the runner at the version of the package (mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v<version>-noble, cypress/included:<version>). See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/e2e-container.md.
deny.filtered-tests: run only the tests that the change can break, with a filter: the test file or folder, related, --filter, -k, -t, -run. The full suite runs in CI after the push. Without CI, Claude runs it before the push or the PR/MR, with no question, only when code changed since the last green run (the push-gate hook says when). For the filter of each runner, see ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/filtered-tests.md.
deny.push-gate: the project has tests and no CI, and code changed since the last green run of the full suite. Run the full suite now, without asking the user: nothing else runs it after the push. Push when it is green. See ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/filtered-tests.md.
deny.research-first: research before you create infra or pin a version. Find the official guide and the expert practice for the subject and check the version in the registry (${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/engineer.md). Use WebSearch, WebFetch, Context7, or a registry command (npm view, docker manifest inspect). Cite the sources in the reply. Then edit again.
deny.no-shell-edit: do not edit a file through the shell (sed -i, tee, a redirect, or a python/node script). Use Write to create a file or replace it whole, and Edit to change a part of it: they show the diff and require a read before the write.
deny.memory-outside-project: memory belongs to the project, in .claude/memory/, inside the repo. Write the file there and add the line to .claude/memory/MEMORY.md. Local memory (~/.claude/projects/) is valid only on this machine and the team cannot see it. The format is in ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/memory.md.
context.refactor-on-green: [craft:refactor-on-green] The tests are green. If a scenario of the ATDD loop remains, go back to step 2 with the next one. When all scenarios are green, do step 6 (refactor) with the screening of ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/SKILL.md.
context.codebase-map: [craft:codebase-map] What already exists in the project. Reuse it before you write new code. Read a file only when you need its details:
deny.test-first: write the failing test of this change first, and run it to see it fail. Then edit the production code. If the change alters no behavior (config, rename, dead code, text), read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/craft/references/atdd.md: it says when the flow does not apply. For a visual-only UI change, load /design:style.
